local p = {}

-- Picks the card template for an item ID. Used by Template:Tooltip.
local Store = require('Module:DataStore')

-- NEW CARD TYPE = one line here: the category of the item (category_name in the API) -> the template that shows it.
-- Every category that is not listed uses DEFAULT.
local REGISTRY = {
	Mount = 'Mount',
	['Marine Mount'] = 'Mount',
	Glider = 'Glider',
	Pets = 'Pet',
	['Powerstone Pet'] = 'Pet',
	['Battle Pet'] = 'Pet',
	-- Potion = 'Consumable',   (listed only as an example, DEFAULT already covers it)
}
local DEFAULT = 'Consumable'

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

-- The category of an item, when the sync script has stored it (nil when not)
local function stored(id)
	local c = Store.get('Cards', id)
	if c and trim(c.category) ~= '' then return trim(c.category) end
	if Store.get('Mounts', id) then return 'Mount' end
	if Store.get('Gliders', id) then return 'Glider' end
	if Store.get('Pets', id) then return 'Pets' end
	return nil
end

-- {{#invoke:Tooltip|stored|ID}} -> "1" when the category is known from the stored data, otherwise nothing
function p.stored(frame)
	return stored(frame.args[1]) and '1' or ''
end

-- {{#invoke:Tooltip|template|id=ID|live=<category from the API>}} -> name of the card template
function p.template(frame)
	local a = frame.args
	local cat = stored(a.id)
	if not cat then
		cat = trim(a.live)
		if cat:find('class="error"', 1, true) then cat = '' end
	end
	return REGISTRY[cat] or DEFAULT
end

-- {{#invoke:Tooltip|flat|<text>}}: makes a tooltip card safe to hang in the middle of a line of text
-- (Template:Item, SkillLink, BuffLink). A card is built from <div> elements, and the browser closes the
-- paragraph of the line at the first <div>: that leaves empty paragraphs (big gaps) between the items of a line.
-- So the card is rewritten here: line breaks become spaces, and every <div> becomes a <span> that looks the same:
-- a div whose classes have a display rule of their own in the card styles keeps that rule, every other div
-- gets display:block. When a card style gets a new class with a display rule (flex, grid, none ...), add the
-- class to OWN_DISPLAY, otherwise that element is shown as a plain block.
local OWN_DISPLAY = {
	['aa-buff-head'] = true, ['aa-buff-title'] = true,   -- Template:BuffLink/styles.css
	['aa-glider'] = true, ['aa-glider-head'] = true, ['aa-glider-skillrow'] = true, ['aa-glider-skills'] = true,
	['aa-glider-title'] = true, ['aa-item'] = true, ['aa-item-head'] = true, ['aa-item-title'] = true,
	['aa-mount'] = true, ['aa-mount-head'] = true, ['aa-mount-title'] = true, ['aa-mskill'] = true,
	['aa-mskill-effect'] = true, ['aa-mskill-head'] = true, ['aa-mskill-icon'] = true,
	['aa-mskill-meta'] = true, ['aa-mskill-metaline'] = true, ['aa-mskill-name'] = true,
	['aa-mskill-none'] = true, ['aa-mskill-tip'] = true, ['aa-skill'] = true, ['aa-skill-anchor'] = true,
	['aa-skill-applier'] = true, ['aa-skill-applyneed'] = true, ['aa-skill-applyrow'] = true,
	['aa-skill-applysub'] = true, ['aa-skill-boost'] = true, ['aa-skill-buff'] = true,
	['aa-skill-buffname'] = true, ['aa-skill-bufftip'] = true, ['aa-skill-chain'] = true,
	['aa-skill-chainlabel'] = true, ['aa-skill-combo'] = true, ['aa-skill-comboicons'] = true,
	['aa-skill-fact'] = true, ['aa-skill-head'] = true, ['aa-skill-req'] = true, ['aa-skill-reqnote'] = true,
	['aa-skill-set'] = true, ['aa-skill-step'] = true, ['aa-skill-stepicon'] = true, ['aa-skill-title'] = true,
	['aa-src-head'] = true, ['aa-src-all'] = true,   -- "Obtained from" part of Template:Consumable/styles.css
	['aa-varmain'] = true, ['aa-varset'] = true, ['aa-varset-v1'] = true, ['aa-varset-v2'] = true,
	['aa-varset-v3'] = true, ['aa-varset-v4'] = true, ['aa-varset-v5'] = true, ['aa-varset-v6'] = true,
}

local function divToSpan(attrs)
	attrs = attrs or ''
	local own = false
	local cls = attrs:match('class="([^"]*)"')
	if cls then
		for c in cls:gmatch('%S+') do
			if OWN_DISPLAY[c] then own = true end
		end
	end
	if not own then
		if attrs:find('style="', 1, true) then
			attrs = attrs:gsub('style="', 'style="display:block; ', 1)
		else
			attrs = attrs .. ' style="display:block"'
		end
	end
	return '<span' .. attrs .. '>'
end

function p.flat(frame)
	local s = tostring(frame.args[1] or '')
	s = s:gsub('%s*\n%s*', ' ')
	s = s:gsub('<div([^>]*)>', divToSpan)
	s = s:gsub('</div>', '</span>')
	return s
end

return p
